Common questions

Which health plan should I pick?

Compare the total yearly cost, not just the premium. Premiums are fixed, while deductibles and coinsurance depend on how much care you use. The comparison tool shows the spending level where each plan becomes the cheaper choice.

  • Health Plan Comparison Calculator
  • HSA: The Only Triple-Tax Account (2026 Guide)
  • Why Employer Health Insurance Costs Are Rising in 2027

How do I get out of debt faster?

List every balance with its rate and minimum payment. Paying the highest rate first (avalanche) costs the least interest; paying the smallest balance first (snowball) brings earlier wins. Either works if the extra payment keeps going.

  • Debt Payoff Calculator
  • Should I Pay Off Debt or Invest? A Decision Framework

Where do I start on a household budget?

Begin with the budget and spending articles: they cover rising health costs, credit-card bills, and worked examples of cutting a large expense without a travel-deal detour.

  • Budget and Spending Blog Archive
  • Why Employer Health Insurance Costs Are Rising in 2027
  • America Got Richer. The Bottom Got Poorer.

Is my family protected if something happens?

Insurance replaces income or covers costs you could not absorb. Check what your employer already provides before buying more.

  • How Much Life Insurance Do I Need?
  • Am I Behind Financially? Benchmarks Without the Guilt

Which airline or hotel program fits how I travel?

Status and points are most useful with the airline or hotel brand you actually use. The Travel & Rewards hub compares programs and whether elite status is worth the cost.
